source_title: Microsoft FY24 Fourth Quarter Earnings Conference Call
claim_relevant_visible_text: The remaining cloud and AI related spend is primarily for servers, both CPUs and GPUs, to serve customers based on demand signals.
researcher_paraphrase: Microsoft said the non-land/build portion of its cloud-and-AI capex was primarily server hardware, with CPU/GPU deployment tied to customer demand signals.
precision_guard: This is primary for Microsoft's own capex composition and demand-linked server procurement. It is not a direct measurement of DRAM, NAND, SSD or HBM purchases and must not be converted into memory bits or supplier revenue.
authority_boundary: The preserved sentence is Microsoft's own earnings-call wording. Research annotations do not turn hyperscaler capex into a memory-demand scalar.
